item.title: Construction & Renovation Portfolio
item.description:
Overview

Since 2019 I’ve worked in residential construction through my family’s business, doing real work on real homes — not internship shadowing, not classroom simulations. I’ve rewired houses, installed thousands of square feet of hardwood, and gut-renovated bathrooms from demolition to final inspection.

I include this in my engineering portfolio intentionally. The skills aren’t separate from my technical work — they inform it. Tracing a circuit fault in a wall is the same systematic thinking as debugging a waveform in ModelSim. Reading a load calculation is applied circuit analysis. Managing a renovation timeline is project management. The hands just happen to hold a wire stripper instead of a keyboard.
